full_prompt_en: A square dark mixed-media portrait shows a solemn youthful face emerging from a heavily worked near-black surface. The background is not a neutral void: fine vertical seams, scratches, scuffs, and small rusty patches run through charcoal and deep brown layers. A broad dark head covering or mass of hair arcs across the upper half and partly swallows the forehead. The face sits just right of center and fills most of the middle, turned only slightly toward the left. Half-lowered eyes look past the viewer, and the expression is quiet and grave. The forehead, nose bridge, cheekbones, and chin are pale gray-ivory, but the modeling is stained by warm earth tones and blue-black shadow. A firm mouth carries a subdued brown-red tint. The far side of the face disappears into darkness, while the near cheek has small black flecks and faint cracks crossing the painted skin. At the upper right, a rounded mottled gray-brown form presses against the head, its nature intentionally unresolved within the darkness. Near the lower left, a small vertical ember-red mark and a few ochre abrasions punctuate the otherwise limited palette. No clothing is distinctly separated from the bottom shadow. The surface appears built through layered paint, scraping, distressing, and partial erasure, with thin straight marks crossing both background and face. A low, directional light from the upper left and front strikes the brow, nose and cheek, but dies rapidly at the temples and jaw. The light gives the face sculptural weight without making the surrounding black space transparent. There is no readable text. The overall composition is close and austere, using a pale, vulnerable central form against damaged dark material to create a hushed, unsettling mood.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形暗调混合媒介肖像描绘一张神情庄重的年轻面孔，从反复经营的近黑表面中浮现。背景不是中性空洞：纤细竖缝、刮痕、擦损和小块锈色斑穿过炭色与深棕层。一大片深色头饰或头发从上半部拱过，局部吞没额头。脸位于中央稍右，占据中部大半，只略向左转。半垂的眼望过观者，神情安静而肃然。额头、鼻梁、颧骨和下巴呈浅灰象牙色，但塑形被暖土色与蓝黑阴影染过。紧闭的嘴带暗棕红色。远侧面庞消失于黑暗，近侧脸颊有小黑斑与淡裂纹横过颜料中的肌肤。右上方，一团圆润、斑驳灰棕形体紧贴头部，在暗处有意保持难辨。左下附近，一道小小竖向余烬红色痕与少量赭色擦损打断原本有限的色域。下方阴影里没有清晰分离出的衣服。表面像由层叠颜料、刮擦、磨损和局部擦除构成，细直痕同时横过背景与脸。低位定向光从左上和前方照到眉、鼻、颊，却在太阳穴与下颌处迅速消失。光赋予面庞雕塑般重量，却没有让周围黑色空间变透明。画中没有可读文字。整体构图贴近而严峻，以浅色、脆弱的中央形体面对受损深暗材料，形成寂静又不安的情绪。
style_prompt_en: The dark mixed-media treatment combines smooth sculptural tonal modeling with visible abrasion, scratched lines, and layered stains. Near-black, charcoal, umber, dull ivory, and a trace of rust red occupy a deliberately narrow color range. A pale focal plane emerges gradually from darkness, its outer contour partly erased by adjacent shadow and damaged texture. Small specks and hairline cracks interrupt otherwise soft gradients, so material wear becomes a central visual feature rather than surface noise. Low directional light touches only a few raised areas and falls off abruptly into deep surrounding black. The frame is tightly cropped with little spatial context, making value, texture, and edge loss carry the emotional weight. The result is austere, intimate, and unsettling.
style_prompt_zh: 这种暗调混合媒介处理把平滑、雕塑般的明暗塑形与可见擦损、划线和层叠污痕结合起来。近黑、炭色、棕褐、暗象牙色及一丝锈红占据刻意狭窄的色域。浅色焦点平面从暗处渐渐浮出，外轮廓部分被邻近阴影和破损肌理擦去。小斑点与发丝般裂纹打断原本柔和的渐层，使材料磨损成为核心视觉特征，而非表面噪点。低位定向光只触碰少量隆起区域，迅速跌入周围深黑。画幅裁切紧密，空间线索很少，明度、肌理和边缘消失承担情绪重量。结果严峻、亲近且令人不安。
theme_en: A solemn face emerging from scratched darkness
theme_zh: 一张庄重面孔从刮擦的黑暗中浮现
name: Nicola Samori
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
